title: Lead Software Engineer - Java, Microservices architecture, Spring Boot, Rest APIs, SQL
description:
**Scope**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of Blue Yonder's next\-generation cloud\-native Supply Chain Data Platform.
* The role involves architecting scalable, secure, and highly available microservices, collaborating with global product and engineering teams, and driving technical excellence across the software development lifecycle.
* The ideal candidate combines strong hands\-on development expertise with architecture, mentoring, and operational excellence


**Our Current Technical Environment**
* Software: Java, Spring Boot, Gradle, Git, Hibernate, REST APIs, OAuth, GraphQL, Snowflake, Scala, Spark, Elasticsearch, NoSQL, RDBMS
* Application Architecture: Cloud\-native, event\-driven, secure multi\-tenant microservices architecture with high scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and high availability
* Cloud Architecture: Microsoft Azure (AKS, ARM Templates, Azure AD, Event Hub, Application Gateway, Virtual Networks, HDInsight), Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD
* Frameworks/Others: Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, Spring Boot, Hibernate, GraphQL, Elasticsearch, Spark, Ignite, Git, Gradle, DevOps, Infrastructure Automation


**What You'll Do**
* Lead the architecture, design, and development of Blue Yonder's next\-generation Supply Chain Data Platform using cloud\-native microservices and event\-driven architecture.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Professional Services, and global engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and high\-quality software solutions.
* Drive engineering excellence through clean code, architecture reviews, performance optimization, code reviews, CI/CD improvements, automation, and operational best practices.
* Mentor engineers, contribute to hiring, lead technical discussions, resolve production challenges through root cause analysis, and continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.
* Participate in the engineering on\-call rotation, providing backend support, incident resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous improvements to platform reliability


**What We Are Looking For**
* 7 to 10 years of strong hands\-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, OAuth, Kafka, Snowflake, and cloud\-native application development on Microsoft Azure or similar cloud platforms.
* Proven experience designing and building scalable, resilient, multi\-tenant SaaS platforms using distributed microservices, event\-driven architecture, Kubernetes, Docker, and DevOps practices.
* Experience with Big Data and distributed technologies such as Snowflake, Spark, Scala, Elasticsearch, NoSQL/RDBMS, along with performance tuning and high\-availability architectures.
* Strong technical leadership with experience in software architecture, secure coding, mentoring engineers, code reviews, stakeholder collaboration, Agile development, and driving continuous improvement across engineering teams.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
